shell_commands: /usr/bin/zsh -lc "pwd && if [ -f ../round-brief.md ]; then sed -n '1,240p' ../round-brief.md; fi && sed -n '1,240p' ../ticket.md && sed -n '1,260p' .lore/dod.md"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "git status --short --branch && sed -n '1,240p' src/orchestration/chatOrchestratorUsageContract.test.ts && sed -n '1,220p' src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.test.ts && sed -n '1,220p' .lore/test-commands.yml && rg -n \"specs/.*#[0-9]+|validated by|VALIDATED_BY|chatOrchestratorUsageContract\" specs src/orchestration -g '*.ts' -g '*.md'"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "rg -n \"receives collected response text and usage|aggregate usage|aggregated across|Status\" src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.test.ts specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md package.json && sed -n '220,420p' src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.test.ts && sed -n '1,180p' specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md && sed -n '1,160p' src/index.ts && rg -n \"AGGREGATED_USAGE_SCOPE|AggregatedUsageMetadata\" src"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "command -v lore-query-trace || true
rg -n \"layers.yaml|no-cross-layer-import\" . --glob 'layers.yaml' --glob '*.md' --glob '*.ts' --glob '*.js' --glob '*.mjs'
sed -n '1,120p' layers.yaml 2>/dev/null || true
sed -n '1,120p' src/types/index.ts
sed -n '1,80p' src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.ts
cat package.json"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'npx prettier --write src/chatOrchestratorUsageContract.test.ts specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md .lore/dod.md && timeout 300 npm test -- --runTestsByPath src/chatOrchestratorUsageContract.test.ts'

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "git status --short && git diff --check && git diff -- .lore/dod.md specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md src/chatOrchestratorUsageContract.test.ts src/orchestration/chatOrchestratorUsageContract.test.ts && nl -ba src/chatOrchestratorUsageContract.test.ts | sed -n '1,30p' && git diff origin/main -- src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.test.ts | rg -n -C 3 \"receives collected response text and usage\" || true && if [ -f scripts/spec-links/reanchor.mjs ]; then echo reanchor-present; else echo reanchor-absent; fi"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'git add .lore/dod.md specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md src/chatOrchestratorUsageContract.test.ts src/orchestration/chatOrchestratorUsageContract.test.ts && git diff --cached --check && git commit -m "fix usage contract test layer" && git push origin HEAD'
/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'git fetch origin main && git merge --no-edit origin/main && git status --short --branch && git rev-list --left-right --count @{upstream}...HEAD'
